card.name: The word as in analogies
card.fires_on: The word "as" (or "of"/"into") right after verbs like regarded, think of it, modeled, conceptualising. It introduces a metaphor or a way of viewing something.

modes.label: Think of it as
modes.description: "as" after "think of it/this" introduces an analogy to explain a concept.
modes.example: Think of it<< as>> a relay race with one runner handing off

modes.label: Regarded/modeled as
modes.description: "as" after a passive or abstract verb such as regarded or modelled, stating how something is represented.
modes.example: The shift register can be regarded<< as>> a second interface to the memory that can

card.writes: It promotes nouns that name a conceptual role or framing, such as territory and backbone.
card.plain: It marks the little word that introduces a comparison, as in "think of it as" or "can be viewed as".
